values.note: Reservation required: call the Sand Hills State Forest office during office hours, (843) 498-6478. Campers must camp in the reserved site; a reservation runs 11 a.m. to 11 a.m. the next day.

booking.source: https://www.scfc.gov/state-lands/sand-hills-state-forest/sand-hills-state-forest-campsite-information/ ('You must call the Sand Hills office during office hours to make camping reservations in order to camp on the property'; 'Campers must obtain a reservation from the Sand Hills State Forest office during office hours'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: A single campsite beside Sexton Pond, west of McBee off Old Creek Road (S-13-296); trash cans by the pond, boat landing nearby.

sites.source: https://www.scfc.gov/state-lands/sand-hills-state-forest/sand-hills-state-forest-campsite-information/ ('three other single campsites without shelters at Hunter Pond, Lee Pond and Sexton Pond'; Sexton Pond site description), read 2026-10-20

values.note: No shelter or restroom at the site; generators are allowed.

facilities.source: https://www.scfc.gov/state-lands/sand-hills-state-forest/sand-hills-state-forest-campsite-information/ (Sexton Pond: 'Site with no shelter or restroom next to Sexton Pond'; 'Generators ARE allowed at campsites'), read 2026-10-20

summary: Confirmed $10/night and phone-only reservations (now fcfs never). Added one site, no restroom, generators allowed. Not stated: season, max stay, booking window, minimum stay, rig length.
flags: Wrong agency row: Sexton Pond is a SC Forestry Commission (Sand Hills State Forest) site but inherits state:SC (SC State Parks), so it shows the state-park 13-month window and 2-night minimum. The Forestry Commission page states neither: it books by phone per day (11 a.m. to 11 a.m.), and AWH stayed a single Friday night here (state:SC row note). Suggest policy_ref 'none' (or a Forestry Commission row) so those inherited values stop showing.
